integrity: The complete integral homotopy assertion follows from explicit acyclic discrete-Morse matchings and signed integer attaching-degree cancellation; independent mod-two ranks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for the nonincidence graph of AG(2,3), with the ordinary open-neighborhood convention. No all-order, equivariant, or external-audit claim. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible. The integral Betti numbers themselves were previously computed via line-free complex Alexander duality (Lew 2021); novelty is restricted to the full homotopy wedge and explicit matching.
title: A mixed-dimensional sphere wedge for the Hesse nonincidence neighborhood complex
